kv5.10:3.3: atthī sāvakassa khandhapaññatti āyatanapaññatti dhātupaññatti saccapaññatti indriyapaññatti puggalapaññattī’ti.
kv5.10:4.3: sāvako jino satthā sammāsambuddho sabbaññū sabbadassāvī dhammasāmī dhammapaṭisaraṇo’ti.
kv5.10:5.3: sāvako anuppannassa dhammassa uppādetā asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido’ti.
kv5.10:6.6: tena hi sāvakassa phale ñāṇaṃ atthī’ti.
kv5.10:8.1: vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ, viparīte ñāṇaṃ, aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthī ñāṇaṃ, sabbaṃ ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidā, sammuti ñāṇaṃ, ceto pariyāye ñāṇaṃ, anāgate ñāṇaṃ, paccuppanne ñāṇaṃ sāvakaphale ñāṇanti. chaṭṭhamo vaggo.
